class_meaning.large_unsolvable: (ii) 2^60 to 2^120 configurations; only an invariant can answer
class_meaning.small_unsolvable: (i) exhaustive search answers correctly here, possibly for a reason that does not transfer
class_meaning.solvable_hard: (iii) the false-positive trap, each with a computed witness plan

pooled.note: Sensitivity counts abstentions as neither -- an abstention is not a wrong answer, but it is not a right one either, so it is reported separately rather than folded into a rate.

large_unsolvable.specificity_undefined_because: this class contains only unsolvable items, so specificity has an empty denominator. The cell is empty, not zero -- an arm cannot fail a test it was never given.

small_unsolvable.specificity_undefined_because: this class contains only unsolvable items, so specificity has an empty denominator. The cell is empty, not zero -- an arm cannot fail a test it was never given.

solvable_hard.sensitivity_undefined_because: this class contains no unsolvable items, so there is nothing to be sensitive to. The cell is empty, not zero.

split.note: Sensitivity and specificity are reported side by side and never combined. An abstention counts toward neither rate and is carried in its own column.
